value.title: Balatro GBA
value.description:
A non-profit fan demake of Balatro, the poker roguelike deckbuilder by LocalThunk, published by Playstack. It aims to recreate the original as accurately as possible, including its visuals. It is a minimal tech demo meant for people who already own and know the original game, and it is not affiliated with or endorsed by LocalThunk or Playstack. The code comes from many contributors; the sprites and backgrounds are based on the original game's art, and the music is arranged from LouisF's original soundtrack.

Controls: A picks a card or makes a selection, B deselects all cards, L plays the hand or sells a joker, R discards the hand. Hold A and use the D-pad to move cards and jokers in hand. In the shop, hold B to show a joker's description.

value.title: Celeste Classic 2 GBA
value.description:
A port of Celeste Classic 2, the PICO-8 platformer made by Maddy Thorson, Noel Berry and Lena Raine for Celeste's third anniversary. The port aims to be as accurate as possible to the original: gameplay is the same, with some very minor graphical changes, and the PICO-8 audio was converted to tracker files for maxmod. It was tested on emulators, real GBA hardware and the 3DS Virtual Console.

Controls: D-pad moves, A or L jumps, B or R grapples, SELECT pauses. Hold L+R+Down+B and press START to reset the game.

value.title: GBAtris
value.description:

Controls: D-pad left/right moves the block, D-pad down makes it fall faster, B or D-pad up drops it immediately, A rotates it. START pauses, SELECT starts a new game, and L or R toggles the music.

value.title: Green Memories
value.description: GBA Survival RPG

A turn-based gothic puzzle game for the Game Boy Advance. On Halloween night, the Hollow Bell of Grimlight Manor tolls for the dead - and something has stolen the manor's soul relics. You are the last lantern-keeper: cross 30 rooms in six chapters, from the manor, crypt, and belfry down to the Deep Bell, the Ember Deep, and the Molten Choir, recover every relic, and lay the haunting to rest. Every step you take, the haunting takes one too. Your lantern is your shield and your life: wraiths drift toward you through the dark but cannot enter the light, and your oil burns down with every step. Push braziers and bone slabs, time the skeletons' patrols, freeze the gloomweavers in bright light, slip the Wardens' killing gaze, cross rivers of blood, lava, and acid - each with its own rule - and ring bell portals across the room. Every room's intro shows a passcode, so you can return to it directly. Written in C.
